packageReadinessCompatibility.meaning: The immutable package has passed artifact-level serving checks; it is not an operational stable-release decision.

compatibility.runtime: exact runtime interface, Python ABI, framework version, architecture, and checkpoint format
compatibility.api: API major versions must match and the request/response schema version must be exact; a changed major requires an explicit migration release
compatibility.data: Task-record schema and contract are exact; a changed data schema requires a versioned migration before activation
compatibility.tokenizer: Tokenizer ID and contract are exact and the tokenizer remains an immutable artifact dependency of the model
compatibility.retrievalIndex: Index ID and major version must match and the index digest is exact; model and index changes require one atomic bundle
